title: Wages (Job Bank), 2025 edition
publisher: Employment and Social Development Canada (Job Bank)
attribution: Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence - Canada. Source: Employment and Social Development Canada, Job Bank Wages.
transformations: Kept NOC 2021 unit groups (5-digit), the economic regions used by our places, provinces, and Canada.
Low/median/high wage kept as published; hourly dollars unless Annual_Wage_Flag = 1 (annual dollars).
Cells with no published wage are omitted (not zero-filled); the Job Bank file refers users to the provincial/national wage in that case.
notes: Wages describe employed workers, not advertised pay. Each cell retains the publisher's period and Data_Source_E methodology; estimates with different periods or methods must not be pooled into a ranking.
Job Bank's ER_Name differs slightly from StatCan for ER 5920 ('Lower Mainland' vs 'Lower Mainland--Southwest') and ER 6010 ('Yukon Territory' vs 'Yukon').
Territories and PEI have a single economic region equal to the territory/province; no separate provincial key is stored.
Cells kept by reference period label: {'2021': 361, '2023-2024': 10495, '2024': 6375}
The newest English wage CSV edition is discovered from the official open.canada.ca catalog; each cell retains its own Reference_Period and Data_Source_E.

ER verification against our places: ER 1110: place list says 'Prince Edward Island / Île-du-Prince-Édouard', Job Bank says 'Prince Edward Island'; ER 3590: place list says 'Northeast / Nord-est', Job Bank says 'Northeast'; ER 3595: place list says 'Northwest / Nord-ouest', Job Bank says 'Northwest'; ER 4610: place list says 'Southeast / Sud-est', Job Bank says 'Southeast'; ER 4630: place list says 'Southwest / Sud-ouest', Job Bank says 'Southwest'; ER 5910: place list says 'Vancouver Island and Coast / Île de Vancouver et la côte', Job Bank says 'Vancouver Island and Coast'; ER 5920: place list says 'Lower Mainland--Southwest / Lower Mainland--Sud-ouest', Job Bank says 'Lower Mainland'; ER 6010: place list says 'Yukon', Job Bank says 'Yukon Territory'; ER 6110: place list says 'Northwest Territories / Territoires du Nord-Ouest', Job Bank says 'Northwest Territories'

title: National Occupational Classification (NOC) 2021 Version 1.0: classification structure and elements
transformations: Unit groups (level 5) with TEER = second digit of the code; broad category = first digit; examples = first six 'Illustrative example(s)' elements.

title: Labour force characteristics by census metropolitan area, three-month moving average, seasonally adjusted
attribution: Source: Statistics Canada, Table 14-10-0459-01. Reproduced and distributed on an 'as is' basis with the permission of Statistics Canada.
transformations: Selected seasonally adjusted rows for the places' CMAs, Ottawa-Gatineau Ontario/Quebec parts and Prince Edward Island; unemployment, employment and participation rates (Estimate) plus standard errors.
1-year change = rate(t) - rate(t-12 months), percentage points; monthly series since 2019-01 kept as published.
notes: Rates are three-month moving averages: each month's value is the average of that month and the two before it, so month-to-month changes are smoothed and overlap.
